description: 04.02 'each target must be: Visible to the model that has that weapon ... Within range of that weapon' with 01.04.01 (a unit is within a distance if one of its models is) and 19.01 (an Attached unit is one unit). Regression: target eligibility read the whole Attached unit, but the PER-MODEL shooter check (RulesEngine.get_eligible_shooter_models — resolve-time filter, split-fire picker, auto-assign, snap assignments) measured the bodyguard dict alone, so an Attached unit within range only through its leader was offered as a target and then every shooting model was dropped: no attacks. Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive, Shooting phase, P1 Custodes: Custodian Guard Alpha's 24" spears reach Warboss Alpha (~23") but no Boy of his Boyz Beta (>24"). The player clicks the Guard in the shooter list; the Boyz are its target, the spears that reach the Warboss are auto-assigned (real filter), Confirm resolves real attack dice against the Attached unit.
